'''Fianna''' was the [[Gender/Legends|female]] owner and head [[Chef/Legends|chef]] of the [[Tapcafe/Legends|café]] known as the [[Draknul Café]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] and the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. The café, which was located in a cliffside neighborhood of [[Kor Vella/Legends|Kor Vella]] [[City/Legends|city]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]], was a popular site for clandestine meetings between nobles and dignitaries. Patrons also traveled from across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] to try the delicacies prepared by Fianna, although she only catered to those she found interesting enough, keeping strict control of the guest list. It was difficult for a customer at the café to reach Fianna and rare for her to speak to any of them, although she was able to tell those who managed to contact her information concerning almost any person, place or event in the [[Corellian system/Legends|Corellian system]].<ref name="SoF" />

==Behind the scenes==
Fianna was first mentioned in ''[[Suns of Fortune]]'', a sourcebook released in [[2014]] for [[Fantasy Flight Games]] ''[[Star Wars: Edge of the Empire]]'' roleplaying system. The book did not mention her [[Species/Legends|species]].
